analysis.original_request: 我负责制冷型碲镉汞红外焦平面探测器的长波红外窗口膜层研发。探测器工作在 8000-11000 nm 长波红外大气窗口，需要该波段尽可能高的透过率，同时尽可能抑制 3000-5000 nm 中波红外的热背景辐射，以降低焦平面的热负载。请在空气入射、锗（Ge）基底条件下，仅使用 ZnS 和 ZnSe 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 16 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar multilayer dielectric film using ZnS and ZnSe on a Ge substrate with unspecified material incidence. The film should have high transmittance in the 8000-11000 nm long-wave infrared band and suppress transmittance in the 3000-5000 nm mid-wave infrared band to reduce thermal load. The total layer count must not exceed 16 layers.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Planar layered media with isotropic materials ZnS, ZnSe, Ge fits TMM scope.

validation_warnings: unrequested material assumptions were replaced with unspecified
unrequested numeric assumptions were replaced with unspecified
